dict.string: FluidWispr uses Accessibility to notice your dictation key in any app and put text where your cursor is.
FluidWispr turns your speech into text on this Mac.
FluidWispr needs system audio access to record the meeting application you explicitly select. Meeting audio stays on this Mac.
FluidWispr needs Screen & System Audio access to record audio from the meeting application you explicitly select.
FluidWispr needs permission to control system events for managing launch at startup settings.
FluidWispr uses on-device speech recognition to transcribe your voice commands and text quickly and privately.
